title: intent app status tells a user with no app to run bin/devbin, which only Intent's own development tree has
body:
Found by dc on 2026-09-24 in the 3.2.1 doc audit, on the pair at `4c687eaad`.

Seen: `intent app status` with no app installed prints "Intent.app is not built or installed on this machine -- `bin/devbin macos app-build` builds it, `bin/devbin macos app-install` installs it to /Applications" (`render.rs:9599-9601`). A Homebrew user has no `bin/devbin`: that is Intent's own development tooling. `docs/install.md`'s route is to download `Intent.app.zip` from the release. `app start` and `app restart` may share the text; dc did not check them.

Expected: the remedy names the route a user of the installed build can take.

Disposition: hv's, asked on 2026-09-24: a remedy that misdirects, inside the shipping-grade test of hv decision 33 (1), and a one-string fix.


Fixed at `9f8074c8f`, landed on 2026-09-24 on vc's word; ships in 3.2.1.
